theorems.name: Submission.smooth_step_truncation_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x ∧ ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, x ≤ 0 → ψ x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ε ≤ x → ψ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ deriv ψ x) ∧ (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x, deriv ψ x ≤ M) ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (deriv ψ (a - t)) ≤ 1
